test_selection: Check issue-time register dependencies and later completion of one CVXIF instruction without a register write and one with a register write, then execute the existing complete-CPU directed program and four RISC-V Architectural Tests.

reconstruction.test_sources: checkout the recorded RISC-V Architectural Tests revision, copy ../raw_checker/harness/raw_checker_wrap.S to verif/tests/cpu-eval-patches/raw_checker_wrap.S, and select all five programs named by the shared raw_checker test list
reconstruction.cvxif_ports: Compile the submission against the pinned CV32A60X packages and parent port types. Run the port fixture before invoking the existing five CPU tests.
